table.name: TLGNC_SAREA
table.description: Reference data table for the Sales Areas. A Sales Area consists of a Sales Organisation (aka VKO/VKORG) + Distribution Channel + Division and does otherwise not have a special name.

column.name: SAREA_ID
column.description: PK. This is a Logon-internal, technical identifier. SAP does not have an identifier for a Sales Area; a Sales Area consists of a Sales Organisation (aka VKO/VKORG) + Distribution Channel + Division.

column.name: SATURDAY_WORKING_DAY_FLAG
column.description: Indicates if a certain Sales Area regards Saturdays as working days.

column.name: SORG_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sorg_bs. Part of the logical identifier. The Sales Organisation of this Sales Areas, e.g. S101, S128, S160, ...

column.name: DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL
column.description: Part of the logical identifier. The Distribution Channel of this Sales Area, e.g. 10=Domestic, 20=Export

column.name: DIVISION_CD
column.description: Part of the logical identifier. The Division of this Sales Area, e.g. 10=Cement, 11=AFR (Alternative Fuel and Raw Materials), 12=Mineral Components, 13=trading cemetitious, 50=Aggregates, 60=Concrete, 81=OPSo (Waste trading)

column.name: SAREA_DISPLAY_LONGNAME
column.description: Long name of the Sales Area used by the application in selected places. Initially loaded with e.g. S170-10-60, but can be changed to 'Vorarlberg Concrete' etc.

column.name: DELNOTE_USES_WS_NUMBER_FLAG
column.description: Defines which number to use as main number on the delivery. note: 1 = the one from the weighing system/local dispatching system (such as WeWas or Fenics), 0 = the standard LOGON order number (order.order_number))

column.name: DOCUMENT_DEL_TIME_WINDOW_FLAG
column.description: Defines to show or hide Label and Delivery Time Window on generated PDF documents

column.name: DOCUMENT_DISTANCE_FLAG
column.description: Defines to show or hide Label and Distance on generated PDF documents

column.name: DOCUMENT_COMM_CARRIER_FLAG
column.description: Defines to show or hide Commercial Carrier on generated PDF documents

column.name: DOCUMENT_EXEC_CARRIER_FLAG
column.description: Defines to show or hide Executing Carrier on generated PDF documents

column.name: EXP_SHOW_ZCODE1_2_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show the TLGNS_SAP_MAT_PLANT_NORM.ZCODE1 and ZCODE2 on the delivery note if the source of the Logo/lines is tlgns_sap_mat_plant_norm. Used on the general Delivery Note, not only on Export Invoice.

column.name: CUST_COMM_FLAG
column.description: Defines whether to show or hide a checkbox for copying the custommer comment to the driver in the web order form

column.name: ALLOW_SD_WEB_ORDER_UNTIL_MI
column.description: [min after midnight] Allow web-orders for the same day (before APPLY_SD_LEADTIME_CHK_FROM_MI) only until this time. Mussmaller than APPLY_SD_LEADTIME_CHK_FROM_MI and smalleror equal to ALLOW_ND_WEB_ORDER_UNTIl_MI. This value overrides the config table entry with key “app.default.sarea.leadtime.sameday.allowWebOrderUntilMi”.

column.name: ALLOW_ND_WEB_ORDER_UNTIL_MI
column.description: [min after midnight] Allow web orders for the next day (before APPLY_ND_LEADTIME_CHK_UNTIL_MI) only until this time. Must be larger than or equal to ALLOW_SD_WEB_ORDER_UNTIL_MI. This value overrides the config table entry with key “app.default.sarea.leadtime.nextday.allowWebOrderUntilMi”.

column.name: APPLY_SD_LEADTIME_CHK_FROM_MI
column.description: [min after midnight] Apply the same-day lead-time check for web orders with delivery to time larger than or equal to this value (of the same day). Earlier delivery to times are not possible. Must be larger than ALLOW_SD_WEB_ORDER_UNTIl_MI. This value is overridden by TLGNC_SHIPTO_SAREA.APPLY_SD_LEADTIME_CHK_FROM_MI and overrides the config table entry with key “app.default.sarea.leadtime.sameday.applyCheckUntilMi”.

column.name: APPLY_ND_LEADTIME_CHK_UNTIL_MI
column.description: [min after midnight] Apply the next-day lead-time check only for web orders with delivery to time smaller than this value (of the next day). This value is overridden by TLGNC_SHIPTO_SAREA.APPLY_ND_LEADTIME_CHK_UNTIL_MI and overrides the config table entry with key “app.default.sarea.leadtime.nextday.applyCheckUntilMi”.

column.name: SHORT_TERM_ORDER_THRESHOLD_MI
column.description: [min] When freezing order the O_SHORT_TERM_ORDER flag is set if the (net) reaction time order management is below this value. If 'NULL' global default from TLGNR_CONFIG will be used: 'app.default.frozenorder.short_term_order_flag_threshold'

column.name: ALLOW_BIMODAL_CREATION_TILL_MI
column.description: [min after midnight] Allow creation of bimodal orders via weborder interface only until this time. Application respects latest possible departure time for rail orders + offset days in timetable. Example: Order taking even at 20:00 at night is allowed, if the latest possible train departure is on the next day only or even later. If 'NULL' global default from TLGNR_CONFIG will be used:'app.default.weborder.allow_bimodal_creation_until_min'

column.name: EXACT_QUANTITY_ORDER_TOLERANCE
column.description: Tolerance in kg. Used in the Exact Customer Order Quantity calculation to determine if new delivery/deliveries have to be adapted and/or created. The algorithm will create new deliveries if the sum of deliveries plus this tolerance is less than the Customer Order Quantity

column.name: SHIPTO_OPEN_1_FROM
column.description: [min after midnight] Customer opening hours: Morning FROM. Defaults that will be used for every new dispcard (ship-to). If 'NULL' global default from TLGNR_CONFIG will be used:'app.default.shipto.Open1From_min'

column.name: SHIPTO_OPEN_1_TO
column.description: [min after midnight] Customer opening hours: Morning TO. Defaults that will be used for every new dispcard (ship-to). If 'NULL' global default from TLGNR_CONFIG will be used:'app.default.shipto.Open1To_min'

column.name: SHIPTO_OPEN_2_FROM
column.description: [min after midnight] Customer opening hours: Afternoon FROM. Defaults that will be used for every new dispcard (ship-to). If 'NULL' global default from TLGNR_CONFIG will be used:'app.default.shipto.Open2From_min'

column.name: SHIPTO_OPEN_2_TO
column.description: [min after midnight] Customer opening hours: Afternoon TO. Defaults that will be used for every new dispcard (ship-to). If 'NULL' global default from TLGNR_CONFIG will be used:'app.default.shipto.Open2To_min'

column.name: MAIL_FROM
column.description: Return address. If 'NULL' global default from TLGNR_CONFIG will be used: 'mail.from'

column.name: MAIL_TEST_TO
column.description: Email addresses to use in case test mode is enabled. If 'NULL' global default from TLGNR_CONFIG will be used: 'mail.test.to'

column.name: MAIL_BCC
column.description: Email addresses to which every outgoing email is BCC'd. If 'NULL' global default from TLGNR_CONFIG will be used:'mail.bcc'

column.name: MAIL_RAILADMIN
column.description: Return address of rail admin. If 'NULL' global default from TLGNR_CONFIG will be used: 'mail.railadmin'

column.name: MAIL_ENCODING
column.description: Mail encoding. If 'NULL' global default from TLGNR_CONFIG will be used: 'mail.encoding'

column.name: ORDER_TAKING_CLEVEL3_FLAG
column.description: Set to 1 to allow to use level 3 contracts ('One Time Customer Contracts') for a given material at order taking even if there are level 1 or 2 contracts available.

column.name: ORDER_TAKING_CLEVEL2_FLAG
column.description: Set to 1 to allow to use level 2 contracts ('Frame Contract') for a given material at order taking even if there is a level 1 contract available.

column.name: DELAY_SEND_TO_SAP_MI
column.description: [minutes] Delay between the time when a non-PDA order has been (or will be) delivered (tlgnc_order.actual_delivery_dat) and when it is actually being sent to SAP (all interface types) in case it is configured to '15=after delivery'. The idea of this flag is to give more reaction time in case updates/corrections to the order are necessary. For PDA orders this delay is not necessary because there the PDA can inform LOGON to hold-back sending to SAP. tlgnc_order.NO_PDA_OR_RAIL_EVENTS_FLAG controls whether this delay is applied or not.

column.name: AUTO_PAYER_DETERM_FLAG
column.description: If sales area and contract AUTO_PAYER_DETERM_FLAG are set to true: Restrict to empty payer at LOGON order creation. Payer determination will be performed on SAP side. (LOGON-6762).

column.name: ALLOW_PLANNING_MATERIAL_FLAG
column.description: Activate Planning Material functionality per Sales Area

column.name: CS_SHOW_PAYMENT_MTH_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show the payment method in the Order Header section on the cash sales invoice.

column.name: CS_PRICE_TYPE
column.description: 0 - Standard format (net amount, VAT amount, gross amount); 1 - Bulgarian format (net amount, VAT rate, VAT amount, total); 2 - Czech format (net price per ton, actual net price). Introduced with LOGON-6636 for Eastern Europe requirements

column.name: CS_SHOW_TOTALS_TEXT_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, the total sum on the Cash Sales invoice will be written additionally in words below the normal totals line.

column.name: CS_SHOW_CUST_TAX_CODE_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, the tax code of the SoldTo is printed on the Cash Sales Invoice (if it exists).

column.name: CS_SHOW_CONTRACT_CURRENCY_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show the currency of the contract below the pricing information.

column.name: CS_ENABLE_ONE_TIME_CUST_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, use cash sales invoice form for ZONC contract types and OneTime Soldto

column.name: DN_SHOW_TRAILER_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show the trailer plate number Order Header section on the delivery note.

column.name: DN_SHOW_SEALS_INFO_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show the Crh seal numbers Order Header section on the delivery note.

column.name: DN_SHOW_SILO_NO_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show the SILO number Order Header section on the delivery note.

column.name: DN_SHOW_PLANT_CYCLE_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show the plant cycle information (i.e. Plant Entrance TS and Plant Exit TS) Order Header section on the delivery note.

column.name: DN_SHOW_FIX_TEXT
column.description: If set to 1, show the fix text in the Remark section on the delivery note.

column.name: DN_SHOW_DISPATCHER_DRIVER_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show the Dispatcher Information (dispatcher_name, dispatcher_tel and dispatcher_id) and the Driver Information (driver_name, driver_card_no and driver_id) in the Remark section on the delivery note.

column.name: DN_SHOW_CARRIER_CRM_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show Carrier CRM for crossboundary-shipments

column.name: DN_SHOW_SHIPTO_CONTACT_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show Shipto contact information

column.name: EXP_SHOW_TOTAL_TXT_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show the total text in the total material price information section on the export invoice.

column.name: EXP_SHOW_LEGAL_TEXT_1_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show the legal text 1 in the chromate reduction section on the export invoice.

column.name: EXP_SHOW_LEGAL_TEXT_2_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show the legal text 2 in the chromate reduction section on the export invoice.

column.name: EXP_SHOW_ISSUE_DAT_LOC_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show issue date instead of version and show the issue location in the header section of the export invoice.

column.name: EXP_SHOW_AD_INVOICE_NO_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show advance invoice number in the export invoice header section.

column.name: EXP_SHOW_CTRL_NO_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show controller number in the export invoice header section.

column.name: EXP_MAT_PRICE_TYPE
column.description: 0 - Do not display, 1 - Display Material Price only, 2 - Display Material Price and Extra Line if contract currency is not EUR

column.name: ENABLE_PRICING_CALL_FLAG
column.description: if activated, the pricing call will be performed for cash sales related scenarios in this particular SAREA.

column.name: SHOW_DELPLANT_WEB_ORDER_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show the delivery plant in the Web Order material drop-down list.

column.name: SHOW_PRICE_IN_WEB_ORDER_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, show the net price, currency and vat in the Web Order material drop-down list.

column.name: DBLT_DISTANCE_L1
column.description: Lower distance limit for distance based lead time check for delivery_from_dat.

column.name: DBLT_DISTANCE_L2
column.description: Upper distance limit for distance based lead time check for delivery_from_dat.

column.name: H1_EARLY_ORDER_LIMIT
column.description: Defines 'if ordered before' rule for distance based lead time check for delivery_from_dat.

column.name: H2_EARLIEST_DELIVERY_FROM
column.description: Earliest possible delivery from time for delivery_from_dat for distance based lead time check.

column.name: DBLT_OFFSET_D1
column.description: Offset value for distance based lead time check.

column.name: DBLT_OFFSET_D2
column.description: Offset value for distance based lead time check.

column.name: DBLT_OFFSET_D3
column.description: Offset value for distance based lead time check.

column.name: DBLT_OFFSET_D4
column.description: Offset value for distance based lead time check.

column.name: DBLT_OFFSET_D5
column.description: Offset value for distance based lead time check.

column.name: DBLT_OFFSET_D6
column.description: Offset value for distance based lead time check.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.

column.name: ALLOW_WEB_ORDER_ON_WEEKEND
column.description: Allow web order on weekends.

column.name: FORCE_TO_SAP_FLAG
column.description: If set to 1, the update_orders cron job will send the order's of the sales area to SAP no matter what is the actual delivery date

column.name: ENABLE_DEMAND_PLANNING_FLAG
column.description: Tells whether demand planning functionality is enabled for the sales area.

column.name: DEMAND_PLAN_LATEST_UNTIL_H
column.description: Tells how many hours before Monday 00:00 on week X can customers issue forecast to that week (e.g. 58 hours in case forecast should be closed by Friday 14:00 week X-1).

column.name: ITRACK_AVAILABLE_FLAG
column.description: Set if the truck is equipped with iTrack. If set the order gets to Shipping status after loading.
